notes.title: Steam Alpha Playtest Content Preview
notes.content:
[h3]Vultures,[/h3][p][/p][p]The September Steam Alpha Playtest is just two weeks away![/p][p]This round builds directly on the feedback you shared in July, with improvements across balance, performance, and core systems. At the same time, we’ve prepared new content to showcase the full scope of Black Vultures to first-time players joining the fight.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re giving you a preview of the maps, gear, and features you’ll experience during the upcoming playtest.
[/p][p]Here’s what awaits you on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][h1][b]// WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/h1][p]Your feedback will continue to shape Black Vultures into a more refined experience. Dive into the core content below and let us know your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]1. Game Modes[/b][/h2][h3][b]  A. Cargo Rush (6v6v6 Quick Match)[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/8510e396af4c1ee9789380ad61d87f2d0fb2d7dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Teams fight to secure the Cargo, transport it to their extraction zone, and hold until the drone arrives. Expect high-intensity close-quarters battles alongside wide-open firefights where tactical weapons turn the tide.[/p][p][i]Your play data from this test will help us balance the maps and shape the ultimate Cargo Rush experience.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]  B. Team Deathmatch (Custom Match Only)[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1241be8b730ab6511f5937f04e702db125a4a8e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A 6v6v6 mode available exclusively through Custom Matches. Designed as a warm-up before jumping into Cargo Rush, it’s the perfect way to test weapons, explore the maps, and sharpen your aim without the pressure of objectives or rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]2. Maps[/b][/h2][h3][b]  A. SNAFU[/b] [/h3][p]A war-torn Eastern European village centered around an industrial complex, with surrounding commercial, residential, and industrial zones. Stacked containers and ruined buildings mark the scars of past battles. Use verticality, cover, and flanking routes to control the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/b6316e488218ad50fb2720b9288706d3fb769594.png"][/img] [/p][h3][b]  B. BLACKBURN (New Map)[/b][/h3][p]A covert refinery buried in the southern deserts of Al Kubra, once a hub for oil smuggling and hidden gold. Sealed off after a devastating chemical strike, it now erupts with conflict as Vultures descend to claim the loot. Narrow sightlines and unforgiving desert terrain demand sharp instincts, rapid adaptation, and ruthless use of tactical weapons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/aafda8e912b145ab36eb18ba0fa485570fcf4c8f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]  C. SYSTEMS & FEATURES[/b][/h3][p]● \[Matchmaking] Cargo Rush supports both Quick Match (MMR-based) and Team Match, where you can form a squad with friends.[/p][p]● \[Team Deathmatch] Available only in Custom Matches. No loot or rewards are earned here, but a great mode for practice and firefights.[/p][p]● \[Ranking System] Track your progress with categories including EXP, Rating, Loot, Combat, Assist, Breach, and Search.[/p][p]● \[Starting Gear] Every account begins with an M4A1 fitted with an underbarrel and scope.[/p][p]● \[Rewards]  Complete a Cargo Rush match to earn rewards. Payouts vary depending on victory, defeat, or MVP status.[/p][p]※ Winning teams keep all the loot collected by their members, which can be viewed in Loot Storage.[/p][p]● \[Loot Crates] Open crates to obtain weapons and attachments, with a chance to secure rare items such as the Drone or RSG60.[/p][p]● \[Shop] Sell unwanted weapons to earn currency and purchase the gear you need. A special Playtest Shop will be available, offering access to weapons normally difficult to obtain.[/p][p]● \[Optimization] Choose from preset graphic options to optimize performance for your PC.[/p][p][/p][p][i]※ Additional systems for crafting gear and parts will also be introduced in the future.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]3. OPERATIVES[/b][/h2][p]Choose from three Operatives, each with unique strengths that shape how you fight. Master their traits and deploy them where they’re needed most:[/p][p][/p][p][b]‣ Vodka[/b] - Slow but durable, built to lead the charge with heavy defense and high HP.[/p][p][b]‣ Mirage[/b] - A true all-rounder, adaptable and effective across any mission.[/p][p][b]‣ Toqui[/b] - Fast and highly mobile, excelling at reaching and securing objectives before anyone else.[/p][p][/p][p]Use their abilities wisely and dominate the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/5b23deb29cd2fd8280985684ed49dc3a19e63434.jpg"][/img] [/p][h2][b]4. PRIMARY WEAPONS & ATTACHMENT CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h2][p]Eight core primary weapons are available, each customizable with a wide range of attachments so you can craft a weapon that fits your playstyle. 

Try high-damage assault rifles like the [b]AK-103[/b], the versatile and mobile [b]M4A1[/b], [b]AK-12[/b] A rifle with decent accuracy and excellent recoil control, the relentless firepower of the [b]MK46 MOD1[/b] LMG, or the long-range precision of the AWM sniper, [b]MK17 MOD0[/b] a battle rifle capable of inflicting lethal damage thanks to its high armor-piercing power, [b]PC7A2[/b] a submachine gun that can deliver burst firepower while remaining easy to control due to its manageable recoil.. New to the September playtest is the [b]CZ BREN 3[/b], offering excellent trigger feel and superior controllability. Mix and match sights, barrels, underbarrels, and more to build the gun that works for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1121ff05202923b2fd7e166a7923a30b1cfc4305.png"][/img] [/p][h2][b]5. SPECIAL WEAPONS[/b][/h2][p]Four high-impact tactical systems are available to change the tide of battle:[/p][p][/p][p]● [b]Suicide Drone[/b] - A one-way explosive drone built for devastating strikes against fortified positions.[/p][p]● [b]Recon Drone[/b] - Scout the battlefield from above to reveal enemy positions and inform your team’s decisions.[/p][p]● [b]PSRL-1 Rocket Launcher[/b] - A precision rocket system designed to eliminate high-value targets and break enemy lines.[/p][p]● [b]RSG60 Mortar[/b] - Devastating area denial firepower, ideal for clearing clustered enemies and holding zones.[/p][p][/p][p]Experience modern warfare with these strategic tools and use them to dominate the battlefield.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/1ed40c747558231a03c04a82659684956ecc13be.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]6. COMMUNICATION FEATURES[/b][/h2][p]Play smarter and have more fun with friends. The new Friends and Party systems let you squad up and coordinate directly:[/p][p]● Search for players and add them as friends.[/p][p]● Create a party and join matches together as a unit.[/p][p]● Use the recent players list to reconnect and team up with new allies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/56ba19806df0124b7ff1720fb918137282c34e6d.png"][/img]  [/p][h2][b]7.  MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT[/b][/h2][p]To make the playtest more accessible and immersive across regions, in-game language settings are now available. Select your preferred language and enjoy the battlefield with greater ease.[/p][p]Supported Languages: Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese[/p][p][/p][h2][b]8. GLOBAL SERVER STRESS TEST[/b][/h2][p]This September playtest expands to Asia, North America, and South America, bringing Vultures from across the world together to test server stability.[/p][p][i]* Your participation provides vital data that will help us deliver a smoother and more stable launch experience.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]※ Black Vultures is powered by Unreal Engine 5, offering hyper-realistic visuals and immersive combat. Performance may vary depending on your PC and network specifications. Adjust your in-game settings for the best play experience.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]9. STREAMING & CONTENT CREATION[/b][/h2][p]There are no restrictions during this playtest. Record, stream, and share freely with the community. Showcase your best plays, strategies, and moments using the hashtag #BlackVultures.[/p][p][/p][p]The development team is eager to meet you once again on the battlefield. Thank you for joining us![/p][p][/p][p]▸ The Black Vultures Team [/p]

notes.title: September Steam Alpha Playtest Confirmed!
notes.content:
[h1]The Steam Alpha Playtest begins September 26![/h1][p][/p][p]Vultures![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the second Steam Alpha Playtest for Black Vultures: Prey of Greed takes place from September 26–28, 2025. Your feedback from July sparked sweeping improvements to combat, refined balance across systems, and a cleaner, more intuitive interface. The game now feels sharper at every turn.
[/p][p]This round expands to Asia, North America, and South America, giving players across the globe a chance to take part. With three days of scheduled sessions and up to six opportunities to jump in, you’ll experience firsthand the progress made since our first test.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]// PLAYTEST DATES[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/6f76d4c4fdf053ff707bb98cf7efac53be11645f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can join all six sessions across the weekend to maximize playtime during the playtest. Please note, however, that connecting outside your region may affect performance.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]// HOW TO JOIN[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Returning Vultures:[/b] If you joined the July Playtest, you can log in again with the same account. No additional registration is required![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Players:[/b] Visit the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/"]Black Vultures Steam page[/url] and click “Request Access” under the Playtest section. Spaces are limited, so register early to secure your chance.[/p][list][*][p]Once approved, you will receive a Steam notification or email. Install the client and be ready to join during your region’s scheduled core hours.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]// KEY DETAILS[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Major Improvements: [/b]Your feedback from July inspired sweeping improvements to combat responsiveness, system balance, and UI clarity. A full breakdown of these changes will be revealed soon, but you’ll feel the difference from the moment you log in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Community Feedback: [/b]Every match and every survey response left a mark on development. July’s test proved how dedicated and insightful this community is, and we’re excited to hear your voices again as we take the next step together.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Development Build:[/b] This remains an early development build of the game. Some features may still be unstable or limited, and we ask for your help in reporting anything you encounter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content Creation:[/b] Streaming, recording, and sharing your experience is encouraged throughout the test. Whether it’s highlight clips, guides, or full matches, we look forward to seeing the game through your perspective.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]// OFFICIAL COMMUNITY[/b][/h2][p]Join us on Discord to share your experiences, connect with other Vultures, and hear the latest updates directly from the team![/p][list][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame"]https://discord.gg/blackvulturesgame[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Support: [url="https://blackvultureshelp@wemade.com"]blackvultureshelp@wemade.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]September marks the next step for Black Vultures. With your passion and feedback, the game continues to grow stronger every day. Be part of the second Alpha Playtest and help forge the future of this game together.[/p][p][/p][p]▸ The Black Vultures Team
[/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #06 - Shaping What Comes Next
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/c7e275da19dd250b3ea218b09f4a736838d9b53b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]Apologies for the radio silence. We’ve been carefully reviewing all the feedback from the first Steam Alpha Playtest and mapping out the road ahead. Rather than rushing out an update, we wanted to take the time to absorb everything you shared and respond with clarity and intent.[/p][p]First and foremost, thank you to everyone who joined us during the test! It was an early build with plenty of rough edges, but your presence and passion helped bring Black Vultures to life in a way we’ll never forget.[/p][p]Your responses, both in-game and through the survey, have already helped shape the next phase of development. We’re now preparing for a second playtest currently scheduled for late September, and we’re excited to share a preview of what’s to come![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Map: BLACKBURN[/b][/h3][list][*][p]SNAFU gave us a strong foundation, but we know variety is key. Our next map, BLACKBURN, is set in a desert oil facility and designed for faster, more intuitive engagements. It offers a different tempo and layout that should challenge your tactical thinking in new ways.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also adjusting lighting and visual elements to improve character readability and make map elements easier to interpret during combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Party Up and Play Together[/b][/h3][list][*][p]One of the most common requests during the first test was a party system. We heard you loud and clear.[/p][/*][*][p]In the next test, you’ll be able to add friends and form squads directly in-game. We’re also working on player search, friend list management, invites, and improved communication tools so you can drop in as a team and coordinate your approach from the very start.[/p][/*][*][p]Our long-term goal is to build deeper co-op features that highlight the importance of teamwork in Black Vultures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]More Meaningful Progress and Rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re introducing a ranking system tied to your play data to bring in competitive motivation and long-term goals. At the same time, we’re adjusting our reward structure to ensure players who fall short of extraction still feel like they’ve earned something meaningful.[/p][/*][*][p]We want to make every match feel more rewarding, regardless of how it ends.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Refining Combat and Character Identity[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re keeping the core combat feel you responded well to, but we’re making targeted balance adjustments. This includes tuning sniper performance and improving weapon-swap behavior during fights to make actions feel smoother and more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also adding passive abilities to characters, giving each one a bit more personality and utility. This should allow players to make more strategic choices about which operator fits their style or the current mission.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Performance and Anti-Cheat[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re optimizing graphic presets and improving performance across the board to ensure smoother play, even on lower-end systems. In parallel, we’re strengthening our security features with both EAC and our own internal measures to protect against cheating and ensure a fair environment for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]The first test was an incredibly valuable experience for us. We’re taking what we learned and using it to deliver a more refined, smoother version of Black Vultures for the second test in September.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Making the Game More Accessible[/b][/h3][list][*][p]It became clear during the first test that while many of you understood the core rules, the flow of the mission and the ticket system weren’t always easy to grasp at the start. We’re working on a short tutorial video that will play as you enter the game, giving a quick overview of the Cargo Rush mission and core game structure to lower the entry barrier.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re also improving the readability and clarity of UI elements like the loadout and respawn screens to reduce confusion during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]And finally, we’re expanding language support to help players around the world enjoy the game more comfortably.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll have more details to share in the coming weeks, but for now, thank you again for helping us take this first step together![/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Our next map, BLACKBURN, is set in a desert oil facility and designed for faster, more intuitive engagements. It offers a different tempo and layout that should challenge your tactical thinking in new ways.

In the next test, you’ll be able to add friends and form squads directly in-game. We’re also working on player search, friend list management, invites, and improved communication tools so you can drop in as a team and coordinate your approach from the very start.

We’re introducing a ranking system tied to your play data to bring in competitive motivation and long-term goals. At the same time, we’re adjusting our reward structure to ensure players who fall short of extraction still feel like they’ve earned something meaningful.

tags.feature: We’re also adding passive abilities to characters, giving each one a bit more personality and utility. This should allow players to make more strategic choices about which operator fits their style or the current mission.

We’re optimizing graphic presets and improving performance across the board to ensure smoother play, even on lower-end systems. In parallel, we’re strengthening our security features with both EAC and our own internal measures to protect against cheating and ensure a fair environment for everyone.
We’re working on a short tutorial video that will play as you enter the game, giving a quick overview of the Cargo Rush mission and core game structure to lower the entry barrier.
We’re also improving the readability and clarity of UI elements like the loadout and respawn screens to reduce confusion during gameplay.
And finally, we’re expanding language support to help players around the world enjoy the game more comfortably.

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #05 - TOQUI: Born from Chaos
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/71a939940bfaede506f484b325d492a8aa699aa4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]Today, we’re introducing one of the most unpredictable operators in Black Vultures: TOQUI.[/p][p]Known for his blistering speed and ruthless efficiency, TOQUI is a combat specialist who believes that mobility is the key to survival. He strips away anything that slows him down, even if it means leaving himself dangerously exposed. In the right hands, TOQUI becomes a blur of violence, striking before the enemy has time to react.[/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at what makes him so lethal.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]TOQUI[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Real Name[/b]: Clayton Lee Brooks (Nickname: Clay)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Age[/b]: Late 30s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Origin[/b]: Southern U.S. (Union of States)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Combat Role and Playstyle[/b][/h3][p]TOQUI prioritizes speed above all else. He forgoes heavy armor and most defensive gear in favor of maximum agility, allowing him to move faster than any other operator. This gives him a major advantage in flanking, repositioning, and striking vulnerable targets before they can respond.[/p][p]His combat style focuses on using tactical mobility to seize key positions and maximize his offensive potential. But the tradeoff is clear. TOQUI’s low durability means that even a single bullet can spell disaster. He demands precision, awareness, and the ability to escape just as quickly as you attack.[/p][p]If you enjoy hit-and-run tactics, exploiting weak points, and outmaneuvering your enemies with raw speed, TOQUI is your ideal pick.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uudpTcEAzZU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Backstory[/b][/h3][p]TOQUI was once a legendary member of the U.S. military’s elite special forces. His career ended in disgrace after he was implicated in a war crimes investigation related to the abuse of prisoners. Though his role was minimal and largely the result of pressure from commanding officers, he was unable to avoid responsibility.[/p][p]He was dishonorably discharged, stripped of all service recognition and benefits.[/p][p]After leaving the military, TOQUI struggled to reintegrate into civilian life. Rejected by society and consumed by shame, he began to spiral. Alcohol took hold, followed by violence. One night, during a drunken argument, he killed his wife and fled to Central America.[/p][p]There, he became a cartel hitman and slipped further into addiction, eventually finding himself on the run once again. He smuggled himself into Europe and eventually arrived in Antiviyane, where the war had opened new opportunities for mercenaries. It was there that he joined the Vultures, a newly independent force that welcomed anyone with the skills to survive, no questions asked.[/p][p]For the first time in years, TOQUI felt like he had found a place he could belong. But years of substance abuse and trauma had left deep scars. He suffered from severe mental instability and frequent psychological regressions. His moral compass had fractured, and he often clung to his squadmates like a frightened child, unsure of what was real.[/p][p]Yet when the battle begins, everything changes. TOQUI becomes something else entirely. His instincts take over and the fragmented man disappears, replaced by a near-perfect engine of war. His movements are sharp. His decisions are clean. His efficiency is terrifying.[/p][p]In that moment, TOQUI is not broken... he is unstoppable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/b7937fe35fea35c7a0105b53435cf295073c498e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]More operator profiles are on the way. Until then, we hope TOQUI gives you another glimpse into the kind of operators who call the Vultures home.[/p][p]We’ll see you in the field soon, Vultures![/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #03 - One Cargo, Three Factions, No Mercy
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/505ee35819aca699eec980587be70da103d7b9f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]It’s time to introduce the core game mode that will define your early operations in Black Vultures. In this dev update, we’re pulling back the curtain on Cargo Rush, a 3-faction showdown built around risk, timing, and precision.[/p][p]If you’ve been wondering what kind of missions you’ll be dropping into during the Steam Alpha Playtest, this is where it all begins.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mission Overview[/b][/h3][p]In Cargo Rush, three factions of six players each enter the battlefield with one goal: secure and extract the Cargo before anyone else.[/p][p]Here’s the basic mission flow:[/p][list][*][p]Secure the Cargo when it spawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Transport it to your faction’s Extraction Point (EP).[/p][/*][*][p]Install the Cargo to initiate extraction.[/p][/*][*][p]Hold the point until the drone arrives.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/5tLCtWs1/Cargo-Rush-RE-800x450.gif"][/img][/p][p]The clock is ticking. Each match lasts up to 30 minutes, and there are multiple win conditions:[/p][list][*][p]Successfully complete a Cargo extraction.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminate all enemy respawn tickets.[/p][/*][*][p]Or, if the match times out and no one has completed an extraction, everyone loses.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]How Cargo Works[/b][/h3][p]Cargo appears 90 seconds after the match begins, at a preset location on the map. Once it spawns, it becomes visible:[/p][list][*][p]White if unclaimed.[/p][/*][*][p]Blue if held by your faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashes in enemy colors every 15 seconds if held by the opposing side.[/p][/*][/list][p]Once your team picks it up, you’ll need to deliver it to your EP and start the extraction sequence. The extraction process takes 120 seconds, divided into three phases (30 seconds, 30 seconds, and 60 seconds). If you’re interrupted, progress is saved up to the last completed phase. When you restart the process, you’ll resume from where you left off.[/p][p]Opposing factions can attempt to halt your extraction by interacting with the Cargo for 3 seconds. Only one player can interrupt at a time, and they can’t be interrupted by anything other than death.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/d2aca4b00fc987c4338369a4d0837444b674a123.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Carrier Role[/b][/h3][p]Whoever holds the Cargo becomes the Carrier.[/p][list][*][p]Carriers move slower than usual.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies within 20 meters of the Carrier are auto-marked for 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]This intel is shared in real-time with all teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]The scan refreshes every 5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Choosing who becomes your team’s Carrier and how you protect them becomes a strategic decision. Moving the Cargo is only half the battle… keeping it in possession is the real challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Respawn System: Life Tickets[/b][/h3][p]Each faction starts with a pool of respawn tickets. Every time you die, one ticket is consumed.[/p][list][*][p]All players get one Personal Ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]Each faction starts with five Team Tickets per player (30 total per faction).[/p][/*][*][p]Every 500 points earned by your faction grants an extra Team Ticket.[/p][/*][*][p]If Team Tickets are depleted, players use their Personal Ticket instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Individual players earn a new Personal Ticket every 500 points, up to five max.[/p][/*][/list][p]Run out of both, and you’re stuck spectating from the sidelines.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Forward Respawns[/b][/h3][p]If the Cargo gets close enough to an Extraction Point, the faction furthest from it unlocks a temporary Outpost spawn point to help them re-engage.[/p][p]This system helps maintain pacing and keeps teams from being left behind. It also reduces overlap in approach paths and gives defenders something more to worry about.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/bc668b7137904aa1018966df242a42c0e56d994a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]ATV Respawn System[/b][/h3][p]Need to get back to the fight fast? That’s where ATVs come in.[/p][p]On the respawn screen, players have the option to spawn directly into an ATV. When selected, you’ll appear just outside your faction’s base, near one of three entry routes into the combat zone.[/p][p]Each faction has three ATVs located in their spawn area. These vehicles act as personal transport, perfect for cutting down travel time and launching a quick flank or deep push toward the objective. If an ATV is destroyed or abandoned, it will automatically respawn at the original base location after about 30 seconds.[/p][p]The ATV system gives players the mobility needed to stay in the action, close the distance, or catch the enemy off guard. Use them wisely. Drive with purpose.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Victory and Defeat[/b][/h3][p]Here’s how each match can end:[/p][list][*][p]One faction successfully extracts the Cargo. They win, others lose.[/p][/*][*][p]All respawn tickets are depleted for two factions. The last faction standing wins.[/p][/*][*][p]Match ends with no completed extraction and remaining tickets. All factions lose.[/p][/*][*][p]Extraction is in progress at timeout. If successful, that faction wins. tags.feature: In Cargo Rush, three factions of six players each enter the battlefield with one goal: secure and extract the Cargo before anyone else.
Cargo appears 90 seconds after the match begins, at a preset location on the map.
Once your team picks it up, you’ll need to deliver it to your EP and start the extraction sequence.
The extraction process takes 120 seconds, divided into three phases (30 seconds, 30 seconds, and 60 seconds).
Opposing factions can attempt to halt your extraction by interacting with the Cargo for 3 seconds.
Carriers move slower than usual.
Enemies within 20 meters of the Carrier are auto-marked for 5 seconds.
This intel is shared in real-time with all teammates.
Each faction starts with a pool of respawn tickets.
All players get one Personal Ticket.
Each faction starts with five Team Tickets per player (30 total per faction).
Every 500 points earned by your faction grants an extra Team Ticket.
If Team Tickets are depleted, players use their Personal Ticket instead.
Individual players earn a new Personal Ticket every 500 points, up to five max.
If the Cargo gets close enough to an Extraction Point, the faction furthest from it unlocks a temporary Outpost spawn point to help them re-engage.
On the respawn screen, players have the option to spawn directly into an ATV.
When selected, you’ll appear just outside your faction’s base, near one of three entry routes into the combat zone.
Each faction has three ATVs located in their spawn area.
If an ATV is destroyed or abandoned, it will automatically respawn at the original base location after about 30 seconds.
One faction successfully extracts the Cargo. They win, others lose.
All respawn tickets are depleted for two factions. The last faction standing wins.
Match ends with no completed extraction and remaining tickets. All factions lose.
Extraction is in progress at timeout. If successful, that faction wins. If not, all factions lose.
We’ve built Cargo Rush from the ground up to encourage aggressive plays, creative flanks, and clutch team coordination.

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #02 - A New Light on the Battlefield
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/fbb817ddc8da257ee14e84183ffc663e5d897801.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Vultures![/p][p]If you’ve seen our first in-game trailer, you probably noticed something we did too. While it captured the direction we were aiming for, it didn’t fully reflect the visual quality we had in mind.[/p][p]At the time, our team was in the middle of implementing Nanite, a key feature of Unreal Engine. That meant we were also rebuilding many lighting systems and overhauling entire scenes to match. The trailer was made during that transitional phase, and we weren’t able to showcase the full potential of the updated environments.[/p][p]We’ve seen your comments. Some said the game looked dated or older than expected. We understand why, and we’ve taken that to heart. Since then, the Nanite-based environments have stabilized, and our lighting setup has been reworked from the ground up.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652406/46a9c80170327e7b339ad0c94d8da5e53dc11f4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The image above shows one of our artists fine-tuning a new lighting pass. After seeing the feedback on the original trailer, he took it upon himself to revisit the scene and bring it closer to the visual standard we’re aiming for in the Steam Alpha Playtest.[/p][p]Although, if you look closely, two enthusiastic colleagues seem to be keeping a very close eye on his progress. Some might say this was purely voluntary. Others might say it was… strongly encouraged.[/p][p]Either way, we’ve taken that feedback seriously. Check out the updated gameplay trailer below, now featuring the improved lighting pass in action.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="N-mmvT6rycg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re pushing hard to raise the bar, and the Steam Alpha Playtest is only the beginning. There’s still a lot we want to refine before launch, and your feedback will play a big part in shaping what comes next.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you soon on the battlefield.[/p][p]▸ The THISMEANSWAR Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622280/Black_Vultures_Prey_of_Greed/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://discord.com/invite/blackvulturesgame" style="button"]Black Vultures Official Discord[/url][/p]
